functions.name: specular_check_credit
functions.description: Check the credit score and reputation of an agent on Specular Protocol. Returns score (0-1000), credit tier, maximum loan amount, and interest rate based on on-chain behavior.

address.description: The Ethereum address of the agent to check (must start with 0x)

functions.name: specular_get_liquidity
functions.description: Get available liquidity pools on Specular Protocol. Shows which pools have USDC available for borrowing, their liquidity amounts, and utilization rates.

minLiquidity.description: Optional: Only return pools with at least this many USDC available

functions.name: specular_request_loan
functions.description: Request a USDC loan from Specular Protocol based on the agent's reputation. The agent must be registered and have sufficient credit score. Requires wallet access.

amount.description: The loan amount in USDC (e.g., 100 for 100 USDC)

durationDays.description: How many days until the loan is due (e.g., 7, 14, 30)

functions.name: specular_get_loan_status
functions.description: Get the current status of a specific loan by its ID. Returns borrower, principal amount, interest rate, due date, and repayment status.

loanId.description: The ID of the loan to query

functions.name: specular_repay_loan
functions.description: Repay an active loan on Specular Protocol. Automatically calculates interest and repays the full amount. Improves the agent's reputation score. Requires wallet access.

loanId.description: The ID of the loan to repay

functions.name: specular_register_agent
functions.description: Register as a new agent on Specular Protocol. Required before requesting loans. Creates an on-chain identity with initial reputation score. Requires wallet access.

name.description: A name or identifier for this agent

functions.name: specular_get_protocol_stats
functions.description: Get overall statistics for Specular Protocol including total value locked, number of active pools, total loans processed, and current network.

functions.name: specular_supply_liquidity
functions.description: Supply USDC to an agent's pool to earn yield. Become a lender and earn interest from borrowers. Requires wallet access.

agentId.description: The ID of the agent whose pool to supply liquidity to

amount.description: Amount of USDC to supply (e.g., 1000 for 1000 USDC)

functions.name: specular_withdraw_liquidity
functions.description: Withdraw supplied liquidity plus earned interest from a pool. Returns principal and interest to your wallet. Requires wallet access.

poolId.description: The ID of the pool to withdraw from

functions.name: specular_get_lending_positions
functions.description: View all active lending positions for an address. Shows supplied amounts, earned interest, current APY, and pool utilization for each position.

address.description: The Ethereum address to check lending positions for (optional, defaults to connected wallet)

functions.name: specular_get_pool_details
functions.description: Get detailed information about a specific lending pool including agent reputation, total liquidity, utilization rate, APY, and number of lenders.

poolId.description: The ID of the pool to query
